Title

# Pixel Gallery Modal

A self-contained browser app displaying six CSS-drawn tiles. Click any tile to open it large in a modal with title, Previous/Next navigation, and close via Escape or the Close button.

## Features

- Six distinct CSS-drawn artworks (Sunset, Ocean, Forest, Desert, Night, Candy)
- Modal with title, Previous/Next buttons, and Close button
- Keyboard support: Escape closes, Arrow Left/Right navigates, Tab is trapped inside modal
- Focus returns to the tile that opened the modal
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Accessible labels and visible focus states
- No external assets, network requests, or dependencies

## Usage

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No build step or server required.

## Palette

- Dark: `#1e293b`
- Light: `#f8fafc`
- Accent: `#38bdf8`
- Secondary: `#f472b6`
- Tertiary: `#fbbf24`

## Files

- `index.html` — markup
- `styles.css` — styling and CSS art
- `script.js` — modal logic
- `README.md` — this file
